sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普在他三岁时的1949年就开始出现在他父亲的商业事务中了。

sentences.en: government-guaranteed loans and keeping the costs so low that he was guaranteed a life of extraordinary wealth.
sentences.zh: 所以文件向我们揭示的是，当唐纳德·特朗普三岁时，他实际上是弗雷德·特朗普的房东。

sentences.en: So as you're going through all of Fred Trump's documents, at what point does Donald Trump appear?
sentences.zh: 弗雷德·特朗普将他建造的大型公寓项目底下的土地过户给他的孩子们，然后开始向他们支付租金。

sentences.en: Donald Trump starts to show up in his father's business affairs when he's three years old in 1949.
sentences.zh: 随着我们开始追踪这些付款，我们发现这些付款让唐纳德·特朗普在九岁时就达到了按当今美元计算的百万富翁水平。

sentences.en: So what the documents revealed to us was that when Donald Trump was three years old, he was actually Fred Trump's landlord.
sentences.zh: 然后在20世纪60年代初，

sentences.en: Fred Trump gives his children the land under these massive apartment projects that he's built, and then begins paying them rent.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德·特朗普开始实际将建筑物，即真正的建筑物，转让给他的孩子们。

sentences.en: And as we begin tracking those payments, we see that those payments made Donald Trump the equivalent of a millionaire in today's dollars by age nine.
sentences.zh: 这是一个占位符为了补足147

sentences.en: And then in the early 1960s,
sentences.zh: 这是一个占位符为了补足148

sentences.en: Fred Trump was beginning to actually transfer buildings, actual buildings, to his kids.
sentences.zh: 这是一个占位符为了补足149

sentences.en: He runs them still.
sentences.zh: 他依然在管理它们。

sentences.en: He does all the labor.
sentences.zh: 所有的苦力活都是他干的。

sentences.en: But on paper, his children are the owners, and the profits for those buildings start going to them.
sentences.zh: 但在纸面上，他的子女们成了所有者，那些建筑的利润开始流向他们。

sentences.en: So Donald Trump, at age 17, became an owner of a 52-unit apartment building in Brooklyn.
sentences.zh: 于是，唐纳德·特朗普在17岁时，就成了布鲁克林一栋52个单元公寓楼的所有者。

sentences.en: And things just keep coming at him.
sentences.zh: 而各种好运也接踵而至。

sentences.en: 1968, he graduates from college, and he lands right into a cushy job at his father's company with a salary.
sentences.zh: 1968年，他大学毕业，顺利进入他父亲的公司，拿着丰厚的薪水。

sentences.en: Fred Trump found a way to make Donald Trump one of his bankers.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德·特朗普想方设法让唐纳德·特朗普成为他的出资人之一。

sentences.en: He gets consulting fees for doing things for his father.
sentences.zh: 他因为替父亲做事而获得咨询费。

sentences.en: He leased a car for him.
sentences.zh: 他为他租了一辆车。

sentences.en: He built his first offices in Manhattan for him.
sentences.zh: 他在曼哈顿为他建造了第一间办公室。

sentences.en: He also found ways to give him the laundry revenue from his buildings.
sentences.zh: 他还想方设法将自己楼宇的洗衣房收入分给他。

sentences.en: And then in 1976, you see this article in the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 然后，在1976年，你看到了《纽约时报》上的这篇文章。

sentences.en: Let me grab it.
sentences.zh: 让我找找看。

sentences.en: And I'll just read you the lead.
sentences.zh: 我直接读给你听开头的导语。

sentences.en: It says, He is tall, lean, and blonde, with dazzling white teeth.
sentences.zh: 上面写着：他身材高大、清瘦、金发，有着耀眼的白牙。

sentences.en: He looks ever so much like Robert Redford.
sentences.zh: 他看起来简直就像罗伯特·雷德福。

sentences.en: He rides around town in a chauffeured silver Cadillac.
sentences.zh: 他坐着有司机驾驶的银色凯迪拉克在城里兜风。

sentences.en: He dates slinky fashion models, belongs to the most elegant clubs, and at only 30 years of age, estimates that he is worth more than $200 million.
sentences.zh: 他与性感迷人的时装模特约会，出入最优雅的俱乐部，年仅30岁时，估计身家就超过了2亿美元。

sentences.en: He took the New York Times reporter on a tour of what he was describing as his empire.
sentences.zh: 他带《纽约时报》的记者参观了他口中的帝国。

sentences.en: Showing this reporter all the things he's done, all the things he's built, all of his jobs.
sentences.zh: 向这位记者展示他做过的一切、建造过的一切，以及他所有的产业。

sentences.en: This building, and this building, and this building.
sentences.zh: 这座建筑、那座建筑、还有那座建筑。

sentences.en: What we now know from looking at these records is that Donald Trump didn't own any of that.
sentences.zh: 通过查阅这些记录，我们现在才知道，唐纳德·特朗普根本不拥有其中任何东西。

sentences.en: Donald Trump hadn't been involved in the building of any of that.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普根本没有参与其中任何建筑的建造。

sentences.en: It's accurate, probably, that he was dating slinky fashion models, but we've come to learn.
sentences.zh: 他当时确实在和性感的时装模特约会，这可能不假，但我们后来了解到。

sentences.en: It was all his father's empire, his father's success, and he was just appropriating all of that as his own to build his own myth.
sentences.zh: 这全都是他父亲的帝国、他父亲的成功，而他只是把这一切据为己有，来打造他自己的神话。

sentences.en: This is sort of like the first instance where you just see the lie begins.
sentences.zh: 这可以说是你看到的谎言开始的最初例证。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mr. Trump, for joining us this morning.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，特朗普先生，今天早上加入我们的节目。

sentences.en: Hiya, Dan.
sentences.zh: 嗨，丹。

sentences.en: I have heard that you are worth something like $3 billion.
sentences.zh: 我听说你的身家大约有30亿美元。

sentences.en: It seemed like in the 1980s, every time you turned on the TV...
sentences.zh: 在20世纪80年代，似乎每当你打开电视……

sentences.en: Well, I've always said, you know, money isn't a totally essential ingredient, but it does make it easier.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我一直都说，你知道，金钱并不是一个完全必不可少的要素，但它确实能让事情变得更容易。

sentences.en: He was there.
sentences.zh: 他在那里。

sentences.en: He's young, he has Robert Redford good looks, and he's rich.
sentences.zh: 他很年轻，有着罗伯特·雷德福般的英俊外表，而且他很富有。

sentences.en: And he was telling you how successful he was.
sentences.zh: 他在向你诉说自己是多么成功。

sentences.en: It's at that point in time when Donald Trump begins to realize, I can say almost anything to reporters.
sentences.zh: 正是在那个时候，唐纳德·特朗普开始意识到，我对记者几乎什么都可以说。

sentences.en: Are you smarter than most people who would call themselves entrepreneurs?
sentences.zh: 你比大多数自称企业家的人更聪明吗？

sentences.en: And it will come to a newer benefit to my image and my reputation, and I can make money off of that reputation.
sentences.zh: 这会给我的形象和声誉带来新的好处，而且我可以利用这种声誉赚钱。

sentences.en: Well, that's an interesting question.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是个有趣的问题。

sentences.en: I don't know if anyone's ever asked me the question.
sentences.zh: 我不知道以前有没有人问过我这个问题。

sentences.en: Am I smarter than other people?
sentences.zh: 我比其他人更聪明吗？

sentences.en: I think that...
sentences.zh: 我认为……

sentences.en: He starts buying casinos, yachts from princes.
sentences.zh: 他开始收购赌场，从王子手里买下游艇。

sentences.en: He buys the Plaza Hotel.
sentences.zh: 他买下了广场酒店。

sentences.en: I just bought the Plaza Hotel in New York and my business, real estate.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚买下了纽约的广场酒店，而我的业务是房地产。

sentences.en: That's the ultimate crown jewel.
sentences.zh: 那是最终极的王冠明珠。

sentences.en: He's able to convince bankers to give him these tremendously outsized loans based just on the image, the myth that he's built for himself already.
sentences.zh: 仅仅凭借他为自己建立的形象和神话，他就能够说服银行家给他提供这些规模惊人的巨额贷款。

sentences.en: And one thing that we found that I don't think anybody ever knew before is that his father goes along with the ride on some of that.
sentences.zh: 我们发现的一点是，我想以前可能没人知道，那就是他父亲在其中某些事情上也推波助澜。

sentences.en: They had this particularly intimate father-son relationship.
sentences.zh: 他们有着这种极其亲密的父子关系。

sentences.en: They talked to each other constantly, and they each shared this view of the world, that the world was this zero-sum game.
sentences.zh: 他们不断地交流，并且都持有这样一种世界观：世界是一场零和博弈。

sentences.en: The idea that your worth in a family matters based on how much money you're making.
sentences.zh: 这种观点认为，你在家庭中的价值取决于你赚了多少钱。

sentences.en: And you were either a killer or you were killed.
sentences.zh: 要么你是个赢家，要么你就会被淘汰。

sentences.en: And there was kind of nothing in between.
sentences.zh: 中间几乎没有灰色地带。

sentences.en: So one of the revelations that we came across in the documents was how Fred and Donald Trump coordinated stock purchases together.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们在文件中发现的一个内幕是，弗雷德和唐纳德·特朗普是如何协同购买股票的。

sentences.en: For example, in the late 1980s.
sentences.zh: 例如，在20世纪80年代末。

sentences.en: New York tycoon Donald Trump wants control of the nation's largest airline.
sentences.zh: 纽约大亨唐纳德·特朗普想要控制全国最大的航空公司。

sentences.en: Donald Trump would leak to the financial press that he was taking a position in American Airlines.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普会向财经媒体泄露消息，称他正在买进美国航空公司的股票。

sentences.en: He doesn't have the financial wherewithal to take over those corporations.
sentences.zh: 他并没有接管那些公司的财力。

sentences.en: But his father, we can see in his tax returns, buys stock in American Airlines.
sentences.zh: 但我们可以从他的纳税申报单中看到，他的父亲购买了美国航空公司的股票。

sentences.en: Then, American Airlines was the most active stock on the big board yesterday, pushing all transportation issues sharply higher.
sentences.zh: 当时，美国航空公司股票昨天成为大盘上交投最活跃的股票，推动所有交通运输板块大幅走高。

sentences.en: The stock goes way up, and his father tries to sell before it goes down.
sentences.zh: 股价大幅飙升，他父亲试图在下跌前抛售。

sentences.en: He doesn't make it.
sentences.zh: 他没能成功。

sentences.en: We saw this pattern in multiple instances.
sentences.zh: 我们在多个事例中都看到了这种模式。

sentences.en: In another case, Donald made a public comment that he was going to take over Time Inc., the magazine and publishing company.
sentences.zh: 在另一个案例中，唐纳德公开表示他将接管时代公司，也就是那家杂志和出版公司。

sentences.en: His father did buy stock right before Donald made those comments.
sentences.zh: 就在唐纳德发表这些言论之前，他的父亲确实买入了股票。

sentences.en: A week later sold it, and he wound up making $40,000 just on his son's hot air, basically.
sentences.zh: 一周后卖掉了，基本上仅仅靠他儿子的空口白话，他就赚了4万美元。

sentences.en: It was a very clear manifestation of these two guys executing financial strategies together.
sentences.zh: 这是这两人共同执行财务策略的一个非常明显的体现。

sentences.en: You know, it was more than just a father-son relationship.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这不仅仅是父子关系。

sentences.en: They were trying to achieve something together in terms of elevating the idea of Donald Trump as self-made billionaire.
sentences.zh: 他们在共同努力实现一个目标，那就是提升“白手起家的亿万富翁唐纳德·特朗普”这一形象。

sentences.en: This goes on for years.
sentences.zh: 这种情况持续了多年。

sentences.en: Uh, ladies and gentlemen, please welcome the author of this book right here.
sentences.zh: 女士们先生们，请欢迎这本书的作者。

sentences.en: Trump, the Art of the Deal, Donald de Trump.
sentences.zh: 《特朗普：交易的艺术》，唐纳德·德·特朗普。

sentences.en: In 1987, Donald Trump published this book, The Art of the Deal.
sentences.zh: 1987年，唐纳德·特朗普出版了这本书《交易的艺术》。

sentences.en: Where do you learn the art of the deal?
sentences.zh: 你在哪里学到交易的艺术的？

sentences.en: I mean, what point were you working with your father, and you knew that there were bigger things for you?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你从什么时候开始跟父亲一起工作，并知道自己会有更大的成就？

sentences.en: Well, I really think you have it, or you don't have it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我真的认为要么你天生就有，要么就没有。

sentences.en: The premise of the book was that he only made good deals, that he could tell the world how to make good deals and get rich on their own.
sentences.zh: 这本书的前提是，他只会做成功的交易，他可以告诉世人如何做成功的交易并靠自己发财。

sentences.en: And you have to go and be driven and, you know, do all the different things that we all sort of know about, and the things I discuss in the book.
sentences.zh: 你必须充满动力，你知道的，去做我们都略知一二的各种事情，以及我在书中所探讨的事情。

sentences.en: But by 1990, all of his bets had gone bad.
sentences.zh: 但到了1990年，他所有的押注都失败了。

sentences.en: He was already getting deep into the hole that would lead to his darkest moment.
sentences.zh: 他已经越陷越深，这将把他带向他至暗的时刻。

sentences.en: Casinos are failing.
sentences.zh: 赌场正在倒闭。

sentences.en: Businesses are failing.
sentences.zh: 企业正在倒闭。

sentences.en: He was just buried in debt.
sentences.zh: 他被债务压得喘不过气来。

sentences.en: He is going through a very rough divorce with Ivana Trump.
sentences.zh: 他正在经历与伊凡娜·特朗普非常艰难的离婚。

sentences.en: What we found, and what people haven't known before, is the degree to which his father helped him out of that hole.
sentences.zh: 我们发现的、也是人们以前所不知道的，是他父亲帮他摆脱这个泥潭的程度。

sentences.en: It was loan after loan after loan.
sentences.zh: 这是一笔又一笔又一笔的贷款。

sentences.en: He owed his father at that point in time somewhere between 15 and 25 million dollars that he never talked about and that he wasn't paying back.
sentences.zh: 当时他欠他父亲1500万到2500万美元之间，他从不提及这笔钱，也没有偿还。

sentences.en: In the financial records that we've obtained, we can see that the flow of money from Fred Trump to
sentences.zh: 在我们获得的财务记录中，我们可以看到弗雷德·特朗普向

sentences.en: Donald Trump increased at moments when Donald Trump was in his highest duress.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普输送资金的力度，在唐纳德·特朗普面临最大压力时有所增加。

sentences.en: He can't make his loan payments.
sentences.zh: 他还不上贷款了。

sentences.en: People are talking about foreclosing, taking away everything.
sentences.zh: 人们在讨论没收抵押品、夺走他的一切。

sentences.en: He gets down at one point to just having a couple of million dollars in the bank, and he's burning through more than that every month.
sentences.zh: 他曾一度落得银行里只剩几百万美元的地步，而他每个月的烧钱速度远超这个数字。

sentences.en: So in the course of our reporting, we've learned that in 1990, in this just really dark period in Donald Trump's life...
sentences.zh: 因此，在我们的报道过程中，我们了解到在1990年，在唐纳德·特朗普生命中这段真正黑暗的时期……

sentences.en: He makes an aggressive play to get more control of his father's wealth.
sentences.zh: 他采取了激进的举措，以获得对他父亲财富的更多控制权。

sentences.en: It's one of the most remarkable discoveries we made along the way.
sentences.zh: 这是我们在整个过程中发现的最惊人的事情之一。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Marc Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收看《重构者》，这是一档聚焦设计之美及相关文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you,
sentences.zh: 甚至早在黑胶唱片时代我在夜店当DJ的时候，你每天晚上都要带着300件你最珍视的宝贝去上班，

sentences.en: and you turned a DJ booth into this living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把一个DJ台变成了一个充满50年历史精美老物件的流动的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看

sentences.en: Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 《时报》订阅者每天都能看到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So what was this remarkable discovery you made in your investigation?
sentences.zh: 那么你在调查中发现了什么惊人的内幕？

sentences.en: So at that crucial point in his life, 1990, we found Donald Trump crafts, in essence, a new will for his father.
sentences.zh: 所以在他人生的那个关键节点，即1990年，我们发现唐纳德·特朗普实质上为他的父亲起草了一份新遗嘱。

sentences.en: It amends the will that's there.
sentences.zh: 它修改了现有的遗嘱。

sentences.en: And then he sends lawyers to his father's house to have him sign it.
sentences.zh: 然后他派律师去他父亲家里让他签字。

sentences.en: His father had no idea this was coming and flipped out.
sentences.zh: 他父亲对此毫不知情，当场气疯了。

sentences.en: And according to the sworn testimony of his relatives, as he read it, he began to realize that what this document would do is that it would give Donald Trump extraordinary control
sentences.zh: 根据他亲属的宣誓证词，当他读到这份文件时，他开始意识到这份文件会做的事，就是让唐纳德·特朗普在他去世后

sentences.en: over his estate upon his death.
sentences.zh: 对他的遗产拥有非同寻常的控制权。

sentences.en: His father was 84 years old, but still an incredibly savvy man, and looked at this and thought, this is my son, who is in incredible trouble right now,
sentences.zh: 他父亲当时84岁，但依然是个极其精明的人，看到这一幕心想：这是我的儿子，他现在遇到了天大的麻烦，

sentences.en: trying to get control of the empire that I built.
sentences.zh: 想要夺取我建立的帝国。

sentences.en: You know, that was a step too far for Fred Trump.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这对弗雷德·特朗普来说太过分了。

sentences.en: This means that my son's creditors could come after my wealth, my empire.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我儿子的债权人可能会冲着我的财富、我的帝国来。

sentences.en: And he shuts the whole thing down.
sentences.zh: 于是他全盘叫停了这件事。

sentences.en: He calls his daughter, Marianne Trump Barry, has her organize a legal team to come up with
sentences.zh: 他打电话给他的女儿玛丽安·特朗普·巴里，让她组织一个律师团队来起草

sentences.en: a new will that will make sure that Donald Trump doesn't have any more control than any of his siblings and that his business problems can't drain his own empire.
sentences.zh: 一份新遗嘱，确保唐纳德·特朗普不会比他的任何兄弟姐妹拥有更多控制权，并确保他的商业问题不会掏空他自己的帝国。

sentences.en: That episode, it is this moment, this jolt.
sentences.zh: 那场插曲，就是这样一个时刻，一次猛烈的冲击。

sentences.en: It kind of triggers a deeper reckoning within the Trump family.
sentences.zh: 它在特朗普家族内部引发了一场更深层次的反思。

sentences.en: It forces them to come to grips with two facts.
sentences.zh: 它迫使他们正视两个事实。

sentences.en: One is that Fred Trump is starting to get frail.
sentences.zh: 一是弗雷德·特朗普开始虚弱了。

sentences.en: His health is failing.
sentences.zh: 他的健康状况正在恶化。

sentences.en: He's starting to suffer the effects of dementia.
sentences.zh: 他开始遭受痴呆症的影响。

sentences.en: And then the kids start to recognize dad has this enormous fortune.
sentences.zh: 然后孩子们开始意识到爸爸拥有如此巨额的财富。

sentences.en: He had all these buildings that were worth hundreds of millions of dollars, and he had tens of millions of dollars running through his bank accounts.
sentences.zh: 他拥有所有价值数亿美元的建筑，而且他的银行账户里流转着数千万美元。

sentences.en: We just couldn't believe when we started looking through the financial records of his companies how much cash he had.
sentences.zh: 当我们开始翻阅他公司的财务记录时，我们简直不敢相信他手里有这么多现金。

sentences.en: And what they were recognizing at that moment was that if Fred Trump died, all of that, every penny of that is subject to a 55 percent estate tax.
sentences.zh: 他们在那一刻意识到的是，如果弗雷德·特朗普去世，所有这一切，其中的每一分钱都要缴纳55%的遗产税。

sentences.en: So that means if Fred Trump passed away and it was worth a billion dollars, 55 percent of all of that goes to Uncle Sam.
sentences.zh: 这意味着，如果弗雷德·特朗普去世时资产价值10亿美元，这一切的55%都将归山姆大叔所有。

sentences.en: And so the Trumps come up with a plan, a plan beyond the bounds of the law.
sentences.zh: 因此，特朗普家族想出了一个计划，一个超越法律边界的计划。

sentences.en: One of the first steps they took was to create something called all-county building supply.
sentences.zh: 他们采取的第一步措施之一，就是成立了一家名为“全县建筑供应”的公司。

sentences.en: All-county building supply and maintenance.
sentences.zh: 全县建筑供应与维修公司。

sentences.en: So Fred Trump bought an enormous amount of goods and services to keep his buildings going.
sentences.zh: 因此，弗雷德·特朗普购买了大量的商品和服务来维持他的楼宇运转。

sentences.en: For years, Fred Trump was buying everything he needed for his buildings directly from wholesalers.
sentences.zh: 多年来，弗雷德·特朗普一直直接从批发商那里购买他楼宇所需的一切物品。

sentences.en: So he needed an air conditioner.
sentences.zh: 所以他需要一台空调。

sentences.en: He'd write a check, get an air conditioner.
sentences.zh: 他会开张支票，买台空调。

sentences.en: He needed paint supplies, go and get paint supplies.
sentences.zh: 他需要油漆用品，就去买油漆用品。

sentences.en: And then all of a sudden, this new company comes along called All-County.
sentences.zh: 然后突然之间，出现了一家名为“全县”的新公司。

sentences.en: And it starts buying everything.
sentences.zh: 它开始购买所有的东西。

sentences.en: So it will pay a hundred dollars for the air conditioner, three hundred dollars for the fridge, hundred thousand dollars for the boiler.
sentences.zh: 所以它买空调花一百美元，买冰箱花三百美元，买锅炉花十万美元。

sentences.en: And then they turn around and they bill Fred Trump for the very same items at this marked up price.
sentences.zh: 然后他们转过头来，以这个加价后的价格就一模一样的物品向弗雷德·特朗普开具账单。

sentences.en: And if they paid 150 for the air conditioner, they then bill Fred Trump 250 and they pocket the difference.
sentences.zh: 如果他们买空调花了150美元，他们就会向弗雷德·特朗普收取250美元，然后把差价装进自己腰包。

sentences.en: Same thing with the fridge and stove.
sentences.zh: 冰箱和炉灶也是如此。

sentences.en: They buy it for 200.
sentences.zh: 他们以200美元的价格买下。

sentences.en: They send an invoice to Fred for 300.
sentences.zh: 他们给弗雷德寄去300美元的发票。

sentences.en: All-county pockets the difference.
sentences.zh: 全县公司吞下了差额。

sentences.en: It's a kind of a middleman that's doing nothing.
sentences.zh: 它就像是一个无所事事的中间商。

sentences.en: This company had no employees it was doing, no negotiating of its own.
sentences.zh: 这家公司没有员工，也没有进行任何自己的业务或谈判。

sentences.en: Literally, it's an invoice padding operation.
sentences.zh: 说白了，这就是一个虚开发票的操作。

sentences.en: All-county was a company set up with the sole purpose of deceiving the IRS.
sentences.zh: 全县公司成立的唯一目的就是欺骗美国国税局。

sentences.en: And we've run this scenario past some of the best tax experts in the country.
sentences.zh: 我们把这个方案交给了国内一些顶尖的税务专家评估。

sentences.en: And every single one of them says, that's fraud.
sentences.zh: 他们每个人的结论都是：这就是欺诈。

sentences.en: It's incredible to think about.
sentences.zh: 想一想真令人难以置信。

sentences.en: One of the things that really jumped out at us is how effective that process was.
sentences.zh: 让我们感到震惊的事情之一，就是这个流程竟然如此高效。

sentences.en: It started out relatively small in 1992, but by 1998, it was generating millions of dollars a year in profits to the Trump children.
sentences.zh: 它在1992年起步时规模还相对较小，但到了1998年，它每年为特朗普的孩子们带来数百万美元的利润。

sentences.en: By the time he dies in 1999, he goes from being a guy who was sitting on tens of millions of dollars of cash to a guy who has less than $2 million left.
sentences.zh: 在他于1999年去世时，他从一个拥有数千万美元现金的人，变成了一个只剩下不到200万美元的人。

sentences.en: His biggest asset is a $10 million debt that Donald Trump owed him.
sentences.zh: 他最大的资产是唐纳德·特朗普欠他的一笔1000万美元的债务。

sentences.en: And that in and of itself is a testament to simply how successful they were at making cash disappear.
sentences.zh: 光是这一点，就足以证明他们在让现金蒸发这方面是多么成功。

sentences.en: But the second part of the scheme was actually maybe the most ingenious and it involved the biggest tax dodge of all.
sentences.zh: 但这个计划的第二部分可能才是最巧妙的，它涉及最大的一笔避税。

sentences.en: By the early 1990s, they're basically through all-county and another entity that they set up getting their father's profits from his empire.
sentences.zh: 到了20世纪90年代初，他们基本上是通过全县公司以及他们设立的另一个实体，来获取他们父亲帝国的利润。

sentences.en: But their father still owns the buildings themselves.
sentences.zh: 但他们的父亲仍然拥有这些建筑本身。

sentences.en: He owned all these buildings, hundreds of millions of dollars, bricks and mortar.
sentences.zh: 他拥有所有这些价值数亿美元的砖瓦实体建筑。

sentences.en: And they're going to take control of that empire through this particular kind of trust that's called a GRAT.
sentences.zh: 他们将通过一种被称为GRAT（个人年金信托）的特殊信托来接管这个商业帝国。

sentences.en: Lots of rich people have truSt. It's a kind of a vehicle for transferring wealth from one generation to the next.
sentences.zh: 许多富人都有信托，这是一种将财富从一代传递给下一代的工具。

sentences.en: But in this case, what the Trumps did is having put all of these apartment buildings in this trust, they then systematically lowballed the value of each apartment building.
sentences.zh: 但在这种情况下，特朗普家人的做法是，在将所有这些公寓楼放入信托后，他们系统性地低估了每栋公寓楼的价值。

sentences.en: They went out and they got an appraiser and the appraisals that came back are just unbelievable.
sentences.zh: 他们找来了一位估价师，而做出来的估价报告简直令人匪夷所思。

sentences.en: They had all of these buildings in Fred Trump's empire appraised so that rather than being what they really were, which was 10, 15, 20 million dollar buildings, instead having
sentences.zh: 他们对弗雷德·特朗普帝国里的所有建筑进行了估价，原本这些建筑真实价值应该是1000万、1500万、2000万美元

sentences.en: them appraised as if they were one to three million dollar buildings.
sentences.zh: 却被估价为仿佛只值100万到300万美元的建筑。

sentences.en: They find an appraiser who says some of Fred Trump's biggest apartment buildings are absolutely worthless.
sentences.zh: 他们找了一个估价师，宣称弗雷德·特朗普最大的一些公寓楼毫无价值。

sentences.en: And they did this over and over and over again.
sentences.zh: 而且他们一遍又一遍地这样做。

sentences.en: And then they pushed the limits in other ways as well to reduce the overall value of this tremendously profitable, massive empire.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，他们还在其他方面突破极限，以降低这个利润极其丰厚、庞大帝国的整体价值。

sentences.en: They put a value ultimately on this empire of 40 million dollars.
sentences.zh: 他们最终给这个帝国估价为4000万美元。

sentences.en: And what we found in our analysis is that in real life, in market value, it was worth at least 10 times that.
sentences.zh: 而我们在分析中发现，在现实中，按市场价值计算，它至少值这个数字的10倍。

sentences.en: This is an empire that less than a decade later, the banks would place a value of almost a billion dollars.
sentences.zh: 这是一个在不到十年后，银行对其估值近十亿美元的商业帝国。

sentences.en: The tax experts that we've interviewed are saying that the way that Trump's took this legal thing and twisted it is in fact illegal.
sentences.zh: 我们采访的税务专家表示，特朗普家人利用合法条文并将其扭曲的做法实际上是违法的。

sentences.en: You're not allowed to submit bogus appraisals to the IRS.
sentences.zh: 你不能向国税局提交虚假的估价报告。

sentences.en: The appraisals really have to reflect reality.
sentences.zh: 估价必须真正反映现实。

sentences.en: I started off with a very, very small amount of money.
sentences.zh: 我起步时的资金非常非常少。

sentences.en: And by the way, when my father passed away, remember I have four, I have a total of five in my family.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，当我父亲去世时，记住我有四个——我家总共有五个兄弟姐妹。

sentences.en: So we have brothers, sisters split.
sentences.zh: 所以我们有兄弟姐妹要分家产。

sentences.en: And my father didn't leave a great fortune.
sentences.zh: 我父亲并没有留下巨大的财富。

sentences.en: It was Brooklyn and Queens real estate.
sentences.zh: 那都是布鲁克林和皇后区的房产。

sentences.en: It's interesting because that estate has, again, fed into this narrative.
sentences.zh: 这很有意思，因为这份遗产再次迎合了这种说法。

sentences.en: When Donald Trump points to it, he can say, look, what my father's estate was only worth, you know, 20, 30 million dollars.
sentences.zh: 当唐纳德·特朗普提及它时，他可以说，看呐，我父亲的遗产只值你知道的2000万、3000万美元。

sentences.en: But now what they do is they build it up like, oh, he left Donald money.
sentences.zh: 但现在他们却把它包装成，哦，他留给了唐纳德一大笔钱。

sentences.en: I started off with one million dollars and now I'm worth over 10 billion dollars.
sentences.zh: 我起步时只有一百万美元，现在我身家超过一百亿。

sentences.en: This guy, the 45th president of the United States, he inherited hundreds of millions of dollars from his father and much of it was gotten through fraudulent means.
sentences.zh: 这家伙，美国第45任总统，从他父亲那里继承了数亿美元，其中很大一部分是通过欺诈手段获得的.

sentences.en: I mean, that's that's an important chapter in his history that should be set straight and people should know about.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是他历史上的一个重要篇章，应该被拨乱反正，人们应该了解真相。

sentences.en: So now that this investigation has been made public, what could come of these revelations?
sentences.zh: 既然这项调查已经公之于众，这些披露会带来什么后果？

sentences.en: Where all this falls, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 这一切最终会走向何方，我不得而知。

sentences.zh: 其中许多事情已经过了诉讼时效。

sentences.zh: 刑事诉讼时效通常将人们面临刑事指控的期限限制在五到七年。

sentences.en: All those clocks have long since told.
sentences.zh: 所有这些时钟早已敲响结束的钟声。

sentences.en: There is still the possibility for the IRS to perhaps penalize the family for what they did, pursue back taxes, issue fines.
sentences.zh: 美国国税局仍然有可能因这个家庭的所作所为对其进行处罚、追缴税款并处以罚款。

sentences.en: The statute of limitations on that is is forever.
sentences.zh: 这方面的诉讼时效是永久的。

sentences.en: So they could come back at any point in time and look at that and impose penalties on them.

sentences.zh: 但本案中的国税局正处于特朗普总统的管理之下。
